evidence.experimental_conditions: GLP Murine LLNA; four mice per dose; doses: 1%, 5%, 10%, 20%, 40% α-isobutylphenethyl alcohol; species: Mus musculus; SI values: 0.7, 0.5, 0.8, 1.2, 1.0 respectively; EC-3 >30%
evidence.support_text: In a GLP Murine Local Lymph Node Assay with doses of 1%, 5%, 10%, 20%, and 40% α-isobutylphenethyl alcohol, no evidence of sensitization was observed. The EC-3 was >30%, corresponding to an estimated potency >7500 µg/cm², and the material was classified as an extremely weak sensitizer or non-sensitizing.
